request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone as the main matte mass, broad dark slate ceramic roofs, aged copper-bronze structural eaves and frames with contained turquoise patina, subtle warm amber only in shallow window panes or a tiny lantern. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. City Citadel: the monumental but COMPACT central keep of knowledge. Three stacked limestone terraces, each with a closed slate roof and copper eaves, forming a dense ziggurat-keep rather than a sprawling castle. No crenellations, no battlements, no flags, no corner turrets, no drawbridge, no moat. A single deep rectangular portal on the lowest terrace. Windows only as simple shallow framed rectangular recessed panels with thick frames, never perforations. Compact architectural base with no surrounding terrain hex, silhouette must fit a tight hexagonal tile. Read clearly as a civic citadel of learning, not a medieval fortress, dwelling, guild, forum, observatory or archive copy. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs 100% closed except the intended portal recess. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, gears, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.
